structure_path.title: PDB 结构路径
structure_path.description: Path to the PDB file passed to ProteinMPNN (needs atom names, so it cannot come from a PdbReader table form).

proteinmpnn_path.title: ProteinMPNN 仓库路径
proteinmpnn_path.description: Checkout containing protein_mpnn_run.py. Empty falls back to OPERON_PROTEINMPNN_PATH.

sampling_temp.title: 采样温度
sampling_temp.description: ProteinMPNN accepts one temperature or a space separated list.

chains.title: 设计链
chains.description: Chain letters for --pdb_path_chains, e.g. AB. Empty designs on all chains.

fixed_positions.title: 固定位置
fixed_positions.description: Positions to keep fixed, e.g. A:1-20,B:5. Mutually exclusive with design_ranges.

design_ranges.title: 设计区间
design_ranges.description: Residues to redesign, e.g. A:97-110,A:26-33 (VHH CDRs). Everything else is held fixed.

python_executable.title: Python 解释器
python_executable.description: Interpreter used for protein_mpnn_run.py. Empty uses the current interpreter.
